name: Push-ups
rangeNote: A fitness test, so there is no lab range: your result is compared with people of your age and sex in published norm tables (shown on this page).
summary: How many push-ups you can do in a row without resting, with good form. It measures the endurance of the chest, shoulder and upper-arm muscles, and depends on body weight, technique and motivation.

high.meaning: More push-ups for your age and sex means more upper-body muscular endurance.

low.meaning: Fewer push-ups for your age and sex means less upper-body muscular endurance. It says nothing on its own about heart health.

sources.title: Association Between Push-up Exercise Capacity and Future Cardiovascular Events Among Active Adult Men
Musculoskeletal fitness and risk of mortality
